matches.quote: The paper says both that PrNiO2 has three-dimensional antiferromagnetic order and that it does not... reduce the claim to "consistent with a finite interlayer coupling".
Fully completed reduction is asserted from the spin dynamics (p. 5) rather than shown directly... check that the elastic and "RE peak" features are not affected by residual NiO3-x
check that the elastic and "RE peak" features are not affected by residual NiO3-x or Ruddlesden-Popper-type secondary phases.
The statement that d_z2 has "a possibly larger energy in the nickelate" is not supported by an uncertainty of 0.58 eV.
The fit of five exchange parameters to one dispersion needs justification... give the parameter correlation matrix, or show that simpler models... fit significantly worse
The incommensurate elastic intensity near (0.2,0.2) and the speculation about stripe order (p. 5) are not supported... Either add such data or shorten this to a brief observation.
The microscopic estimate in Tables II-III has adjustable inputs... Delta = 8 eV was "chosen sufficiently larger than U also providing reasonable results", which reads as tuning.
Near Gamma, the PNO magnon sits within one or two resolution widths of a very strong elastic line and has the largest error bars in Fig. 3a.
The claim that self-doping leaves spin order nearly intact while chemical doping destroys it rests on a cross-material, cross-study comparison... compare against doped infinite-layer nickelates
list the crystal-field and other single-ion parameters used;
The assignment and interpretation of the 0.7 eV feature and the d_xy anomaly in the polarimetric data are speculative and not consistent with the stated agreement with single-ion theory.
Epitaxial strain differs between the two films, and this is not discussed when the exchange constants are compared.

notes: C8 and C18 concern whether apparent magnon dispersion and CCO d_xy mode positions track multi-peak fits/intensity maxima; P7 raises the analogous multi-peak fitting sensitivity issue for PNO d_xy dispersion rather than for the magnon or CCO colormap maximum, so C8 and C18 are marked not raised. C9 is marked partly because P11 critiques the tuned selection of Delta, hopping, and U in Table II but does not mention the 1-band vs d-p U distinction.
